name: The English Lake District
countries: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
description: In Cumbria, northwest England, the Lake District is a compact region of rugged fells and sixteen major lakes, carved by Ice Age glaciers. It holds England's highest peak, Scafell Pike, and its longest lake, Windermere. Dry-stone walls divide the farmed valleys, and the scenery inspired Romantic poets and painters, and an early movement to protect beautiful landscapes.
